inline int addmod(int a, int b) { a += b; if (a >= MOD) a -= MOD; return a; }
inline int submod(int a, int b) { a -= b; if (a < 0) a += MOD; return a; }
inline int mulmod(ll a, ll b) { return (int)(a * b % MOD); }
inline int powmod(int a, int e) {
    int r = 1;
    while (e) { if (e & 1) r = mulmod(r, a); a = mulmod(a, a); e >>= 1; }

    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);

    cin >> N >> M >> MOD;

                int cur = mulmod(mulmod(j-1, mulmod(ways[i-1], ways[n-i])), C[n-1][i-1]);
                mad[n] = addmod(mad[n], cur);
                mad[n] = addmod(mad[n], mulmod(mulmod(mad[i-1], ways[n-i]), C[n-1][i-1]));
                mad[n] = addmod(mad[n], mulmod(mulmod(mad[n-i], ways[i-1]), C[n-1][i-1]));

int N, M, MOD;

struct Mint {
    int v;

        v = (int)(x % MOD);
        if (v < 0) v += MOD;
    }
    Mint& operator+=(const Mint& o) { v += o.v; if (v >= MOD) v -= MOD; return *this; }
    Mint& operator-=(const Mint& o) { v -= o.v; if (v < 0) v += MOD; return *this; }
    Mint& operator*=(const Mint& o) { v = (int)((ll)v * o.v % MOD); return *this; }
    friend Mint operator+(Mint a, const Mint& b) { return a += b; }
    friend Mint operator-(Mint a, const Mint& b) { return a -= b; }
    friend Mint operator*(Mint a, const Mint& b) { return a *= b; }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    cin >> N >> M >> MOD;

    vector<vector<Mint>> C(N+6, vector<Mint>(N+6));

        C[i][0] = C[i][i] = Mint(1);
        for (int j = 1; j < i; ++j)

using namespace std;
using ll = long long;

int N, M, MOD;

ll modpow(ll a, ll e, ll mod) {
    ll r = 1;
    while (e) {
        if (e & 1) r = r * a % mod;
        a = a * a % mod;
        e >>= 1;
    }
    return r;
}

ll modinv(ll a) {
    return modpow(a, MOD-2, MOD);
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(0);
    cin >> N >> M >> MOD;

    // direct combination computation with factorial and inverse factorial
    auto fact = vector<ll>(N+6, 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= N+5; ++i) fact[i] = fact[i-1] * i % MOD;
    auto invfact = vector<ll>(N+6, 1);
    invfact[N+5] = modinv(fact[N+5]);
    for (int i = N+5; i >= 1; --i) invfact[i-1] = invfact[i] * i % MOD;
    auto C = [&](int n, int k) -> ll {
        if (k < 0 || k > n) return 0;
        return fact[n] * invfact[k] % MOD * invfact[n-k] % MOD;
    };

    vector<ll> ways(N+1, 0), mad(N+1, 0);
    ways[0] = 1;
    for (int n = 1; n <= N; ++n) {
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            ways[n] = (ways[n] + (ll)(n+1) * ways[i-1] % MOD * ways[n-i] % MOD * C(n-1, i-1)) % MOD;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; ++j) {
                ll term = (ll)(j-1) * ways[i-1] % MOD * ways[n-i] % MOD * C(n-1, i-1) % MOD;
                mad[n] = (mad[n] + term) % MOD;
                mad[n] = (mad[n] + mad[i-1] % MOD * ways[n-i] % MOD * C(n-1, i-1)) % MOD;
                mad[n] = (mad[n] + mad[n-i] % MOD * ways[i-1] % MOD * C(n-1, i-1)) % MOD;
            }
            for (int j = 1; j <= n-i+1; ++j) {
                ll term = (ll)(j-1) * ways[i-1] % MOD * ways[n-i] % MOD * C(n-1, i-1) % MOD;
                mad[n] = (mad[n] + term) % MOD;
                mad[n] = (mad[n] + mad[i-1] % MOD * ways[n-i] % MOD * C(n-1, i-1)) % MOD;
                mad[n] = (mad[n] + mad[n-i] % MOD * ways[i-1] % MOD * C(n-1, i-1)) % MOD;
            }
        }
    }

    vector<vector<ll>> WAYS(N+1, vector<ll>(N+1, 0)), MAD(N+1, vector<ll>(N+1, 0));
    for (int n = 0; n <= N; ++n) WAYS[n][0] = 1;
    for (int n = 1; n <= N; ++n) {
        for (int m = 1; m <= n; ++m) {
            if (n == m) {
                WAYS[n][m] = ways[n];
                MAD[n][m] = mad[n];
            } else {
                WAYS[n][m] = WAYS[n-1][m];
                MAD[n][m] = MAD[n-1][m];
                for (int l = 1; l <= m; ++l) {
                    WAYS[n][m] = (WAYS[n][m] + WAYS[n-l-1][m-l] % MOD * ways[l] % MOD * C(m, l)) % MOD;
                    ll t = (WAYS[n-l-1][m-l] * mad[l] + ways[l] * MAD[n-l-1][m-l]) % MOD;
                    MAD[n][m] = (MAD[n][m] + t * C(m, l)) % MOD;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    cout << MAD[N][M] % MOD << '\n';
    return 0;
}

    a += b;

}
inline ll mulmod(ll a, ll b) {
    return (a * b) % MOD;

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    cin >> N >> M >> MOD;

    // precompute Pascal triangle in a rectangular array (only needed up to N+5)
    C.assign(N+7, vector<ll>(N+7, 0));
    for (int i = 0; i <= N+5; ++i) {
        C[i][0] = C[i][i] = 1;
        for (int j = 1; j < i; ++j)
            C[i][j] = addmod(C[i-1][j-1], C[i-1][j]);
    }

    ways.assign(N+1, 0);
    mad.assign(N+1, 0);
    ways[0] = 1;

    // single loop combining both symmetric contributions for mad
    for (int n = 1; n <= N; ++n) {
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            ll base = mulmod(mulmod(ways[i-1], ways[n-i]), C[n-1][i-1]);
            ways[n] = addmod(ways[n], mulmod(n+1, base));
            // The two inner loops can be merged since they sum over j=1..i and j=1..n-i+1
            // but note that some terms repeat? We'll compute separately to be safe.
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; ++j) {
                ll term = mulmod(mulmod(j-1, base), 1); // j-1 times base
                mad[n] = addmod(mad[n], term);
                mad[n] = addmod(mad[n], mulmod(mad[i-1], mulmod(ways[n-i], C[n-1][i-1])));
                mad[n] = addmod(mad[n], mulmod(mad[n-i], mulmod(ways[i-1], C[n-1][i-1])));
            }
            for (int j = 1; j <= n-i+1; ++j) {
                ll term = mulmod(mulmod(j-1, base), 1);
                mad[n] = addmod(mad[n], term);
                mad[n] = addmod(mad[n], mulmod(mad[i-1], mulmod(ways[n-i], C[n-1][i-1])));
                mad[n] = addmod(mad[n], mulmod(mad[n-i], mulmod(ways[i-1], C[n-1][i-1])));
            }
        }
    }

    WAYS.assign(N+1, vector<ll>(N+1, 0));
    MAD.assign(N+1, vector<ll>(N+1, 0));
    for (int n = 0; n <= N; ++n) WAYS[n][0] = 1;

                MAD[n][m] = mad[n];

                WAYS[n][m] = WAYS[n-1][m];
                MAD[n][m] = MAD[n-1][m];

#include <iostream>

using namespace std;
using ll = long long;

int N, M, MOD;

int addmod(int a, int b) {
    int s = a + b;
    if (s >= MOD) s -= MOD;
    return s;
}
int submod(int a, int b) {
    int d = a - b;
    if (d < 0) d += MOD;
    return d;
}
int mulmod(ll a, ll b) {
    return (int)(a * b % MOD);
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(0);
    cin >> N >> M >> MOD;

    vector<vector<int>> C(N+6, vector<int>(N+6, 0));
    for (int i = 0; i <= N+5; ++i) {
        C[i][0] = C[i][i] = 1;
        for (int j = 1; j < i; ++j)
            C[i][j] = addmod(C[i-1][j-1], C[i-1][j]);
    }

    vector<int> ways(N+1, 0), mad(N+1, 0);
    ways[0] = 1;

    // For each n, compute ways and mad
    for (int n = 1; n <= N; ++n) {
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            int base = mulmod(mulmod(ways[i-1], ways[n-i]), C[n-1][i-1]);
            ways[n] = addmod(ways[n], mulmod(n+1, base));
            // The two loops are essentially the same except for the range of j
            // We could combine them but keep split for clarity.
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; ++j) {
                int t = mulmod(mulmod(j-1, base), 1);
                mad[n] = addmod(mad[n], t);
                mad[n] = addmod(mad[n], mulmod(mad[i-1], mulmod(ways[n-i], C[n-1][i-1])));
                mad[n] = addmod(mad[n], mulmod(mad[n-i], mulmod(ways[i-1], C[n-1][i-1])));
            }
            for (int j = 1; j <= n-i+1; ++j) {
                int t = mulmod(mulmod(j-1, base), 1);
                mad[n] = addmod(mad[n], t);
                mad[n] = addmod(mad[n], mulmod(mad[i-1], mulmod(ways[n-i], C[n-1][i-1])));
                mad[n] = addmod(mad[n], mulmod(mad[n-i], mulmod(ways[i-1], C[n-1][i-1])));
            }
        }
    }

    vector<vector<int>> WAYS(N+1, vector<int>(N+1)), MAD(N+1, vector<int>(N+1));
    for (int n = 0; n <= N; ++n) WAYS[n][0] = 1;

    for (int n = 1; n <= N; ++n) {
        for (int m = 1; m <= n; ++m) {
            if (n == m) {
                WAYS[n][m] = ways[n];
                MAD[n][m] = mad[n];
            } else {
                WAYS[n][m] = WAYS[n-1][m];
                MAD[n][m] = MAD[n-1][m];
                for (int l = 1; l <= m; ++l) {
                    int part1 = mulmod(WAYS[n-l-1][m-l], ways[l]);
                    WAYS[n][m] = addmod(WAYS[n][m], mulmod(part1, C[m][l]));
                    int part2 = addmod(mulmod(WAYS[n-l-1][m-l], mad[l]), mulmod(ways[l], MAD[n-l-1][m-l]));
                    MAD[n][m] = addmod(MAD[n][m], mulmod(part2, C[m][l]));
